product_family: Lightning AI is a comprehensive cloud AI platform with AI Studio (collaborative GPU notebooks), AI Notebooks, GPU Clusters, Model APIs, Batch Jobs, and Inference services. Built by the creators of PyTorch Lightning.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Homepage enterprise section lists 'SOC2 & HIPAA compliance' under 'Loved by developers. Trusted by IT.' Dedicated vendor doc page https://lightning.ai/docs/security/compliance/soc2-type2 loads with page title 'SOC 2 Type II | Lightning AI', confirming Type II attestation on the vendor's own domain.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Homepage enterprise section lists 'SOC2 & HIPAA compliance' and displays a 'HIPAA' badge. Dedicated vendor doc page https://lightning.ai/docs/security/compliance/hipaa-compliance loads with page title 'HIPAA | Lightning AI'. BAA availability and terms are not confirmed in public docs; this reflects a HIPAA-compliance posture rather than a signed BAA guarantee.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Homepage displays a 'GDPR' badge in the enterprise section. Privacy policy names Grid.ai, Inc. dba 'Lightning AI' as controller for European data protection purposes and appoints VeraSafe Ireland Ltd (Cork, Ireland) as its EU representative under GDPR Article 27, with GDPR data-subject rights and privacy@lightning.ai contact documented.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found. Compliance page exists but specific ISO 27001 certification not mentioned in available documentation or search results.

certifications.name: ISO 27017
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found. No mention in available documentation.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found. Not mentioned in security or compliance documentation.

privacy.ai_training_note: Policy unclear. Lightning AI provides training and inference services for customer models, but explicit policy on whether Lightning AI trains its own models on customer data or uses it for model improvement not found in publicly available documentation. Terms reference 'operational purposes' only for administrative access.
privacy.data_region: Multiple options available. Customers can select data residency location. Lightning AI supports AWS, GCP, and private cloud deployments.

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: AES-256 encryption for all volume (disk) data on Lightning AI Studios; AWS KMS support for enterprise customers managing S3 buckets

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: Industry-standard TLS encryption. Specific protocol versions not documented in publicly available materials.

security.name: Authentication & Access Control
security.value: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) available via SSO with Google and GitHub; role-based access controls (RBAC); fine-grained data access controls; API key authentication

security.name: Audit Logging
security.value: Audit logs available for enterprise deployments; activity logging for compliance tracking

security.name: Network Security
security.value: VPC support; private cloud deployment options; Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) option; network isolation controls

security.name: Vulnerability Management
security.value: No specific public disclosure about vulnerability disclosure program or penetration testing frequency found

products.name: AI Studio
products.data_scope: User code, models, datasets processed on platform
products.notes: Collaborative GPU workspace with persistent storage, AI-assisted debugging and code generation

products.name: AI Notebooks
products.notes: Persistent GPU notebooks with collaborative features and AI assistance

products.name: GPU Clusters
products.data_scope: Training data, model weights, computational outputs
products.notes: Managed training/inference clusters; supports SLURM, Kubernetes, or Lightning's multi-cloud orchestration

products.name: Model APIs (LitServe)
products.data_scope: API inputs/outputs, model parameters, inference logs
products.notes: Pay-per-token APIs for serving models; supports custom models and pre-built options; OpenAI-compatible API format

products.name: Batch Jobs
products.notes: Run batch work on 1000s of GPUs with fractional, pay-as-you-go pricing

compare.pricing_model: Freemium + consumption-based. Free plan ($0), Pro ($50/month), Teams ($140/month), Enterprise (custom). Pay-per-token for Model APIs; hourly rates for GPU compute.
compare.data_residency: Managed multi-cloud (AWS, GCP, Lambda, Nebius, NScale, Voltage) with customer choice of region; Private VPC option; Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) for on-premises or customer-controlled deployments

flags: SOC 2 Type II certification is claimed on the homepage, but the specific audit period or validity date is not confirmed in public documentation.
HIPAA compliance claimed but specific BAA availability and terms not confirmed in publicly available documentation
AI training data policy is unclear; Lightning AI provides training services but does not explicitly state whether it trains on customer data or uses customer interactions for model improvement
Grid.ai, Inc. is the legal entity operating as Lightning AI, founded by the creators of PyTorch Lightning (William Falcon, CEO).
ISO 27001 and other ISO standards are not found in public documentation despite a comprehensive security docs site.
Data residency options clearly documented, but specific data centers and redundancy/replication policies not detailed in available materials
